component.name: Gosh AppImage Manager
component.summary: Inspect, integrate, update and remove AppImages

description.p: Gosh AppImage Manager is a native application for safely inspecting, integrating, launching, organizing, updating, and removing AppImages. Opening a file never integrates or executes it. Made by Gosh.

The application is written in Rust with libcosmic (COSMIC Epoch). Gear Lever was used as a behavioural reference only. This is an independent original implementation and is not endorsed by Gear Lever's authors.
Metadata is extracted without executing AppImages by default. Updates are downloaded to staging, validated, and applied atomically with rollback.

description.p: Native libcosmic rewrite. Made by Gosh. Full Gear Lever workflow parity with System/Light/Dark mode and multi-arch Flatpak.
